name: primitives-effects-click
title: Click
description: A row of labelled demo buttons; pressing one draws a short white effect at the pointer, with variants for a ring, a ripple, a crosshair, a burst and particles.
use: Buttons or icons need playful tap feedback that confirms where the pointer landed.
avoid: Effects fire on pointer only, so keyboard activation shows nothing, and five variants add noise.
a11y: The effect fires only on pointerup, so keyboard-triggered clicks give no feedback; reduced motion is respected. (keyboard: no, labels: n-a, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Five dark grey rounded buttons in a row on a black stage, the fifth centred below, each with a white capitalised label. A small grey caption under the row tells you to click.
behaves: Clicking anywhere on a button spawns the chosen effect at the pointer: an expanding circle, a filled ripple, four ticks pulling outward, a fan of strokes or a spray of dots. Each fades within a second.
customise: Pass children to wrap plus variant, colour, size, duration, scope and disabled; the five effect shapes and easing curves are fixed in source.
weight: light: Each click mounts a few SVG shapes for under a second; idle at rest.
demo: Buttons reading Ring, Ripple, Crosshair, Burst and Particles, with the caption Click a button to see its effect.
issues: Crosshair and burst marks are thin on the dark stage and easy to miss.
The caption is small grey text with weak contrast against black.
polishWhy: Clean dark buttons and varied effects; thin lines on black make two variants hard to see.
